Here is the complete, cited inventory of code-review and validation mechanisms present at `41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c`.

---

## Repository-Wide Mechanisms

### 1. CI Gate Architecture (Two Required Aggregates)

Two GitHub Actions workflows run on `pull_request` + `merge_group` and each terminate in an `if: ${{ always() }}` aggregate job that branch protection can require as a single stable check name.

- **`PR / CI Gate / Required`** — [`pr.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.github/workflows/pr.yml?L719-L791): collects 18 named job results; fails on any `failure` or `cancelled`; accepts `skipped` only for `CHECK_NO_BEADS_CHANGES` on `merge_group`.
- **`PR Risk / CI Gate / Required`** — [`pr-risk.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.github/workflows/pr-risk.yml?L321-L364): collects 8 job results; accepts skipped embedded jobs only when `detect-ci-tier` outputs `full_embedded != true`.
- The evaluator script is `.github/scripts/ci-gate.sh` (referenced from both workflows).
- Design rationale and the list of check names that **must not** be directly required are documented in [`engdocs/CI_REQUIRED_CHECK_TOPOLOGY.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/engdocs/CI_REQUIRED_CHECK_TOPOLOGY.md).
- **Observation**: as of `2026-05-26` the live ruleset `Protect main - light` enforces deletion/non-fast-forward but does **not** currently require status checks (stated in [`CI_REQUIRED_CHECK_TOPOLOGY.md` line 62-64](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/engdocs/CI_REQUIRED_CHECK_TOPOLOGY.md?L62-L64)).

---

### 2. Linting

| Layer | Mechanism | File |
|---|---|---|
| CI | `golangci-lint` v2.10.1, `--build-tags=gms_pure_go`, 5m timeout | [`pr.yml` L531-L535](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.github/workflows/pr.yml?L531-L535) |
| Local hook | `pre-commit`: `gofmt -w` auto-stages, then `golangci-lint run --new-from-rev=HEAD --fix` | [`.githooks/pre-commit`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.githooks/pre-commit) |
| pre-commit framework | golangci-lint v2.10.1, trailing-whitespace, end-of-file-fixer, check-yaml, check-added-large-files | [`.pre-commit-config.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.pre-commit-config.yaml) |

Enabled linters in [`.golangci.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.golangci.yml): `depguard`, `errcheck`, `gosec`, `misspell`, `unconvert`, `unparam`, `sloglint`.

`depguard` mechanically enforces the storage-boundary rule from `engdocs/PROJECT_CHARTER.md`: all `github.com/dolthub` imports are denied outside `internal/storage/**`, `internal/doltserver/**`, and a small named exception list ([`.golangci.yml` L24-L62](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.golangci.yml?L24-L62)).

---

### 3. Build-Tag Policy Check

[`scripts/check-build-tags.sh`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/scripts/check-build-tags.sh) (invoked in `check-build-tags` job on both `pr.yml` and `main.yml`) verifies that every `go build|test|run|generate|install` invocation in tracked scripts, hooks, and CI carries `-tags=gms_pure_go`. This prevents ICU-linkage regressions. Policy rationale is in `engdocs/ICU-POLICY.md`.

---

### 4. CGO Contamination Guard

Job `check-cmd-bd-puregeo-tests` (in both [`pr.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.github/workflows/pr.yml?L86-L118) and `main.yml`) compiles `cmd/bd`, `internal/storage/embeddeddolt`, and `internal/tracker` test binaries with `CGO_ENABLED=0`. The job comment explicitly names the origin: cgo-test-contamination fix for `mybd-ycx / GH#3683`, following up PR #3704 where untagged test files silently neutered the pure-Go test subset.

---

### 5. Migration Hygiene Check

[`scripts/check-migration-hygiene.sh`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/scripts/check-migration-hygiene.sh) runs on every PR and every push to `main`. Three failure classes correspond directly to named historical incidents (audit epic `bd-6dnrw`):

- **Check A**: Duplicate migration version numbers (PR 4027 incident).
- **Check B**: Nondeterministic SQL — `UUID()`, `UUID_SHORT()`, `NOW()`, `RAND()`, and migration-time `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP` — unless the file is in a `nondeterminism-allowlist.txt` with a justification (PR 4039 / issue #4259 incident).
- **Check C**: Modification, deletion, or rename of a migration file that already exists on the base branch (PRs 3991/3918/3942 incident). Skips with a warning if no base ref is resolvable.

`CODEOWNERS` places `internal/storage/schema/migrations/` and `scripts/check-migration-hygiene.sh` under `@gastownhall/beads-maintainers`, with an explicit note that GitHub only enforces this when branch protection has "require review from Code Owners" enabled (`bd-6dnrw.23`).

---

### 6. Version Consistency

[`scripts/check-versions.sh`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/scripts/check-versions.sh) is called in:
- CI job `check-version-consistency` in `pr.yml` and `main.yml`.
- The `pre-push` git hook, which calls it and refuses the push on tag-pushes (`refs/tags/v*`) if versions are inconsistent ([`.githooks/pre-push` L25-L37](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.githooks/pre-push?L25-L37)).

---

### 7. Generated-Docs Freshness

- CI job `check-doc-flags` in `pr.yml` runs `scripts/check-doc-flags.sh` and `scripts/check-doc-freshness.sh` against the binary built in CI ([`pr.yml` L148-L185](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.github/workflows/pr.yml?L148-L185)).
- On failure, the exact regeneration patch is uploaded as artifact `cli-docs-freshness-patch`.
- **Docs Autofix workflow** ([`docs-autofix.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.github/workflows/docs-autofix.yml)): triggered by `workflow_run` on PR failures; downloads the patch artifact, validates every path against an anchored allowlist, and either pushes the fix commit to the PR branch (same-repo, with `DOCS_AUTOFIX_TOKEN`) or posts an apply-recipe comment (forks). The workflow runs on the base branch only — it never checks out or executes PR code.

---

### 8. Formatting Check

`fmt-check` job in both `pr.yml` and `main.yml` runs `make fmt-check` (gofmt). This is one of the 18 required jobs feeding the baseline aggregate gate.

---

### 9. Contract Corpus (Golden + Determinism + Conformance)

Job `contract-corpus` in `pr.yml` ([lines 469-504](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.github/workflows/pr.yml?L469-L504)):
- Runs the entire `cmd/bd/protocol` package (not a `-run` subset).
- Enforces a committed golden corpus: regenerated from the branch's `bd` binary and byte-compared to `testdata/corpus/`. An unreviewed wire change is a hard failure; fix is `make corpus-regen`.
- Runs a double-run determinism check.
- Requires `BEADS_PROTOCOL_REQUIRE_DOLT=1` (a failed container is a hard failure, not a skip).
- Comment explicitly explains why a `-run` filter must never be reintroduced: it was the mechanism that kept conformance tests red on `main` for ~3 months while every CI run was green.

---

### 10. Storage-Layer Conformance

- [`conformance.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.github/workflows/conformance.yml): runs `scripts/conformance.sh` against the embedded Dolt oracle on every PR.
- `pr-risk.yml`: `test-embedded-conformance` runs `TestConformance` sharded into `core` and `audit` partitions (split because the combined suite exceeds 30m under runner variance). `test-server-storage` runs the same `RunAll` suite against a container-backed server-mode Dolt backend.

---

### 11. Regression Tests

[`regression.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.github/workflows/regression.yml): differential regression against a pinned baseline version (`v0.49.6`). A detector job decides whether to run based on:
1. PR labels `run-regression` / `skip-regression` (explicit override).
2. Whether changed files match a `risky_pattern` covering CLI, storage, types, regression, or build-input paths. Test-only files are excluded from the trigger.

Always runs on `push` to main and `workflow_dispatch`.

---

### 12. Package Gates (MCP and npm)

`detect-package-gates` job in `pr.yml` and `main.yml` runs `scripts/ci/detect-package-gates.sh`, which outputs boolean flags consumed by `package-mcp` and `package-npm`. These conditionally run and are included in the baseline aggregate gate. Both verify the built artifact via `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` before use.

---

### 13. CODEOWNERS

[`.github/CODEOWNERS`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.github/CODEOWNERS) assigns `@gastownhall/beads-maintainers` to:
- `cmd/bd/init.go`, `cmd/bd/init_*.go`, `cmd/bd/init_safety*.go` — with an explicit reviewer obligation to verify `CheckRemoteSafety`'s guard matrix tests before approving. The comment traces the root cause: 8+ paper-over commits before ADR 0002 codified the invariant.
- `engdocs/adr/0002-init-safety-invariants.md`
- `internal/storage/schema/migrations/` and `scripts/check-migration-hygiene.sh`

---

### 14. PR Template and Merge Discipline

- [`PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md): three required sections — What, Why, Verification.
- [`PR_MAINTAINER_GUIDELINES.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/PR_MAINTAINER_GUIDELINES.md?L61-L88) codifies merge discipline rules explicitly referencing the 2-month, 440-PR audit (epic `bd-6dnrw`): no self-merge of nontrivial changes, no merge over unresolved `CHANGES_REQUESTED`, PR body must match the diff, no empty or bot-only approvals, revert ping-pong is explicitly prohibited (the five-merges-in-two-hours pattern is named).
- [`CONTRIBUTING_PR_GUIDELINES.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/CONTRIBUTING_PR_GUIDELINES.md): one layer per PR; prove the bug in beads itself with a beads-only repro; benchmarks required for performance claims.

---

### 15. `.test-skip` Registry

[`.test-skip`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.test-skip) exists and is empty (header line only). Its purpose per `CONTRIBUTING.md` is to track known-broken tests rather than silently skip them.

---

## Deterministic Verification Queries

The following can be run mechanically against the revision to confirm the observations above.

```bash
# 1. List all jobs in the baseline CI gate (pr.yml) and their requirement status
grep -E 'needs:|CI_GATE_REQUIRED:' .github/workflows/pr.yml

# 2. Confirm the migration hygiene script checks all three failure classes
grep -c 'Check [ABC]:' scripts/check-migration-hygiene.sh
# Expected: 3

# 3. Confirm CODEOWNERS covers migrations and hygiene script
grep 'migrations\|check-migration-hygiene' .github/CODEOWNERS

# 4. Confirm depguard denies github.com/dolthub in non-storage packages
grep -A2 'deny:' .golangci.yml | grep 'dolthub'

# 5. Confirm the CGO_ENABLED=0 compile job covers cmd/bd, embeddeddolt, tracker
grep 'CGO_ENABLED.*0' .github/workflows/pr.yml | head -5

# 6. Confirm the corpus job runs the entire package, not a -run subset
grep -A3 'contract-corpus' .github/workflows/pr.yml | grep 'run:'

# 7. Confirm .test-skip is empty of test names
wc -l .test-skip && cat .test-skip

# 8. Confirm check-versions.sh is called from pre-push on tag pushes
grep -n 'check-versions' .githooks/pre-push

# 9. Confirm docs-autofix.yml never checks out PR head (security model)
grep 'ref:' .github/workflows/docs-autofix.yml
# Expected: no result (it uses the default, base branch checkout)

# 10. Confirm regression workflow uses label override and path-pattern detection
grep -E 'run-regression|skip-regression|risky_pattern' .github/workflows/regression.yml
```

[`scripts/check-versions.sh`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/scripts/check-versions.sh) is called in:
- CI job `check-version-consistency` in `pr.yml` and `main.yml`.
- The `pre-push` git hook, which calls it and refuses the push on tag-pushes (`refs/tags/v*`) if versions are inconsistent ([`.githooks/pre-push` L25-L37](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.githooks/pre-push?L25-L37)).

---

### 7. Generated-Docs Freshness

- CI job `check-doc-flags` in `pr.yml` runs `scripts/check-doc-flags.sh` and `scripts/check-doc-freshness.sh` against the binary built in CI ([`pr.yml` L148-L185](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.github/workflows/pr.yml?L148-L185)).
- On failure, the exact regeneration patch is uploaded as artifact `cli-docs-freshness-patch`.
- **Docs Autofix workflow** ([`docs-autofix.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.github/workflows/docs-autofix.yml)): triggered by `workflow_run` on PR failures; downloads the patch artifact, validates every path against an anchored allowlist, and either pushes the fix commit to the PR branch (same-repo, with `DOCS_AUTOFIX_TOKEN`) or posts an apply-recipe comment (forks). The workflow runs on the base branch only — it never checks out or executes PR code.

---

### 8. Formatting Check

`fmt-check` job in both `pr.yml` and `main.yml` runs `make fmt-check` (gofmt). This is one of the 18 required jobs feeding the baseline aggregate gate.

---

### 9. Contract Corpus (Golden + Determinism + Conformance)

Job `contract-corpus` in `pr.yml` ([lines 469-504](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.github/workflows/pr.yml?L469-L504)):
- Runs the entire `cmd/bd/protocol` package (not a `-run` subset).
- Enforces a committed golden corpus: regenerated from the branch's `bd` binary and byte-compared to `testdata/corpus/`. An unreviewed wire change is a hard failure; fix is `make corpus-regen`.
- Runs a double-run determinism check.
- Requires `BEADS_PROTOCOL_REQUIRE_DOLT=1` (a failed container is a hard failure, not a skip).
- Comment explicitly explains why a `-run` filter must never be reintroduced: it was the mechanism that kept conformance tests red on `main` for ~3 months while every CI run was green.

---

### 10. Storage-Layer Conformance

- [`conformance.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.github/workflows/conformance.yml): runs `scripts/conformance.sh` against the embedded Dolt oracle on every PR.
- `pr-risk.yml`: `test-embedded-conformance` runs `TestConformance` sharded into `core` and `audit` partitions (split because the combined suite exceeds 30m under runner variance). `test-server-storage` runs the same `RunAll` suite against a container-backed server-mode Dolt backend.

---

### 11. Regression Tests

[`regression.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.github/workflows/regression.yml): differential regression against a pinned baseline version (`v0.49.6`). A detector job decides whether to run based on:
1. PR labels `run-regression` / `skip-regression` (explicit override).
2. Whether changed files match a `risky_pattern` covering CLI, storage, types, regression, or build-input paths. Test-only files are excluded from the trigger.

Always runs on `push` to main and `workflow_dispatch`.

---

### 12. Package Gates (MCP and npm)

`detect-package-gates` job in `pr.yml` and `main.yml` runs `scripts/ci/detect-package-gates.sh`, which outputs boolean flags consumed by `package-mcp` and `package-npm`. These conditionally run and are included in the baseline aggregate gate. Both verify the built artifact via `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` before use.

---

### 13. CODEOWNERS

[`.github/CODEOWNERS`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.github/CODEOWNERS) assigns `@gastownhall/beads-maintainers` to:
- `cmd/bd/init.go`, `cmd/bd/init_*.go`, `cmd/bd/init_safety*.go` — with an explicit reviewer obligation to verify `CheckRemoteSafety`'s guard matrix tests before approving. The comment traces the root cause: 8+ paper-over commits before ADR 0002 codified the invariant.
- `engdocs/adr/0002-init-safety-invariants.md`
- `internal/storage/schema/migrations/` and `scripts/check-migration-hygiene.sh`

---

### 14. PR Template and Merge Discipline

- [`PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md): three required sections — What, Why, Verification.
- [`PR_MAINTAINER_GUIDELINES.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/PR_MAINTAINER_GUIDELINES.md?L61-L88) codifies merge discipline rules explicitly referencing the 2-month, 440-PR audit (epic `bd-6dnrw`): no self-merge of nontrivial changes, no merge over unresolved `CHANGES_REQUESTED`, PR body must match the diff, no empty or bot-only approvals, revert ping-pong is explicitly prohibited (the five-merges-in-two-hours pattern is named).
- [`CONTRIBUTING_PR_GUIDELINES.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/CONTRIBUTING_PR_GUIDELINES.md): one layer per PR; prove the bug in beads itself with a beads-only repro; benchmarks required for performance claims.

---

### 15. `.test-skip` Registry

[`.test-skip`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/.test-skip) exists and is empty (header line only). Its purpose per `CONTRIBUTING.md` is to track known-broken tests rather than silently skip them.
